assessment.evidence_level_note: EVIDENCE.md: selection set = reported set caps the level at task. Edits persist and are reused, but no independent task shows the retained edits help.
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Author-reported, one 15-iteration run (~$7,000): agents promoted by argmax utility on a fixed 50-question SWE-Bench Verified subset, 50 LiveCodeBench items and two synthetic tasks score higher on those same items than iteration 0 (SWE-Bv 0.17→0.51 final, 0.53 peak), with much of the early gain from faster editing under a 300 s timeout; no gain on AIME/GPQA. No held-out set, fixed-improver control, ablation or repeat; compounding self-improvement is not shown.
unresolved: SWE-Bv accuracies are not integer proportions of 50 (opus:O04); aggregation unstated.
Held-out evaluation, independent lineages, fixed meta-agent comparison.

G.reason: Opus sides with sol. The fixed object is named with a source (ADAS's separate, fixed meta-agent editing one DSL forward function) and neighbours are listed, but the closest self-referential neighbours (Gödel Agent, STOP) already let the improver modify itself; the residue claimed against them is scope (full Python codebase, coding benchmarks), and the stake ('hopefully compounding') is asserted. Real gap, incomplete residual against the nearest neighbours = anchor 2; son55's 3 takes the authors' distinctions at face value.

M.reason: Both seats 3; re-checked. Archive → archive analysis of best/worst problems → edit own code → evaluate → argmax promotion is reconstructable with a multi-objective utility; the key hypothesis (self-reference compounds) is not turned into a distinguishing prediction.

X.reason: Both seats 3; re-checked. Full prompts, utility, timeouts, archive tooling, the 14 accepted changes and released code make the chain reconstructable. Deductions: no named immutable anchor (overseer and synthetic benchmarks are editable, opus:O06/O07), no rollback/crash rule, greedy promotion on noisy scores.

E.measurement.reason: Opus sides with son55. SWE-Bench Verified and LiveCodeBench tests are credible verifiers, but the 300 s cap makes accuracy partly a speed measure (opus:O08, A2: metric satisfiable by a non-target factor), Table 1 accuracies are not integer proportions of the 50-item denominator with no stated aggregation (opus:O04), and the symbol benchmark has admitted data-quality defects.

E.causality.reason: Both seats 1; re-checked. Only an iteration trajectory with feature annotations; no fixed meta-agent, ADAS-style or random-edit control, no per-feature ablation; the speed/timeout explanation is conceded by the authors.

E.holdout.reason: Opus sides with son55. The same fixed subsets drive promotion and are reported (opus:O01, opus:O03), and the improver reads per-problem failures of that set (opus:O02); no held-out split, contamination audit or second model. Results exist but are selection-contaminated — rated 1 as for POET (cal-h1-v2 1901.01753) where selection and test coincide; 0/not_reported is kept for papers with no evaluation split at all.

E.statistics.reason: Both seats 2 (A2 ladder: interval on the test metric, no cross-run variance). Fig. 3/4 show 95% CIs on mean utility; the headline accuracy has none, is one meta-run, and is the series peak (opus:O05).

E.cost.reason: Both seats 3; re-checked. Total ≈$7,000 for 15 iterations plus per-iteration $/time/tokens/cache; no alternative optimiser to compare budgets against.

reason: Complete pinned v2 text incl. appendices A–D; in scope (A): the agent's own code (tools, sub-agents, prompts) is edited from benchmark feedback, archived and reused; all eight items resolved.

resolutions.reason: Literal definitional match (fixed component of an iterative procedure freed); assumption_audit_and_pivot is about assumptions under guarantees/defenses.
As primary; no sub-card fits.

One entry per main card with its best sub. SICA archives every iteration but always promotes the argmax, i.e. a single elitist lineage (H19); H20's load-bearing element, a parent rule beyond 'pick the top scorer', is absent. H20's archive traits are recorded as condition notes on the H19 entry.

Kept as an informational check although the card is not the final match: differentiation from the closest precedent (Gödel Agent/STOP) is argued only by scope — it supports G=2.

Verified: 14 changes listed (Appendix D), none ablated.

Verified: failure mode present — one fixed subset promotes and reports (opus:O03).
Verified: single run, greedy promotion on a jittery series (opus:O05).
Not unknown: the text puts the overseer and the synthetic benchmarks inside the editable codebase and names no immutable anchor (opus:O06, opus:O07). Already charged under X (no rating change).
Verified: utility and caps fixed by the authors; editable boundary not stated.
Verified: no separate selection/report sets, one lineage.
Verified: no fixed-improver comparison or ablation of the self-applied part.
Same check (held-out tasks / independent seeds) as H19 step 4, which sol answered unmet; H20 is not a final match.
